milestone: Implement and independently review K1/K2 before bounded real-reader validation.
decision_changed: Whether the exact C4 reader can expose its removed CAR median without altering sorter traces, and whether pulse-to-sorter lag can be frozen without candidate-unit labels.

inputs.domain: synthetic bounded int16 binaries and integer session-clock event arrays only

k1.trace_path: same channel map, sign inversion, per-native-batch temporal centering, lower median CAR, reader FFT high-pass, padding/core crop, whole-batch artifact zeroing, then channel subset
k1.side_channel: the exact lower median removed before CAR, passed through the same FFT high-pass and core crop; zeroed whenever the reader whole-batch artifact rule zeroes traces
k1.equality: post-CAR float32 traces must be bitwise equal to the unmodified exact reader

detector.alignment: strict-left/non-strict-right local minimum; deepest-first refractory suppression with earlier-sample tie break

k2.clock: integer acquisition samples with a nonempty clock identity
k2.detections: all detections whose channel ID is 251 or 252; cluster/unit labels are neither accepted nor used
k2.peak_tie_break: maximum count, then minimum absolute lag, then smaller signed lag
k2.width: contiguous full width at count >= ceil(peak_count/2), reported as inclusive lag bounds and number of sample bins
k2.interpretation: descriptive frozen lag and width only; no positive-control pass threshold is inferred

acceptance: exact equality across ordinary, join, first/final padding, channel subset, sign, no-filter and artifact-zero fixtures
side channel matches an independently constructed known answer
detector threshold, local-minimum alignment, refractory and tie behavior pass known answers
K2 CCG peak/width, channel filter, lag convention, clock and noninteger guards pass known answers
frozen source and results receive same-host independent review
outputs: compact source, tests and JSON receipts only; create-only immutable evidence packet
stop_conditions: any trace mismatch, nonfinite value, shape, clock or known-answer mismatch
recording, sort, RF, holdout, motion, C4, package or service access

scope.can_establish: K1/K2 construction and arithmetic on synthetic fixtures bound to the exact reader source
scope.cannot_establish: real-window equality, 0804 pulse rate, the real lag, sorting benefit, biological identity/purity, or run readiness
